docs.title: enable_kvpp
docs.text:
KVPP（KV 流水线并行）总开关：把 MLA/SFA 非混合模型在 TP 各 rank 间冗余的 KV cache 按层分摊，同等显存容纳更多上下文 token 或并发请求。 📚 所属专题：6. KV 复用与池化

属性 值 类型 bool 默认值 false 状态 ✅ active（Experimental） 适用 非混合 MLA/SFA 模型（如 DeepSeek 系列、GLM-5.2）

docs.title: 用法
docs.text:
vllm serve deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3 \
  --additional-config='{"enable_kvpp": true}'

docs.title: 机制
docs.text:
• KVPP 将 KV cache 的所有权按层划分到 TP 各 rank，而非每 rank 存全量副本，显存容量随 TP 数近似线性放大。
  • 官方 GLM-5.2-W4A8C8 实测：单机 8 卡 TP8+EP 时 KV 容量 6.25×；两机 TP8+PP2+EP（38/40 层）时 5.35×（该数字仅对文中配置成立，非吞吐倍数）。
  • 可与 TP/EP/PP/PCP 组合；PCP 时按 TP × PCP 的层分摊域划分。
  • 可与前缀缓存、KV 池化组合（--kv-transfer-config 的 AscendStoreConnector + kv_producer/kv_both + 整块加载；Mooncake 分层池化为 Experimental）。
  • 派生的 kvpp_config 不是用户可设的顶层键，而是 enable_kvpp=true 后由 KVPPConfig.from_vllm_config 自动注入（size = TP × PCP），启动时校验通过即生效。

docs.title: 注意事项
docs.text:
• 与 DCP 互斥：decode_context_parallel_size != 1 时启动报错。
  • 仅非混合 MLA/SFA 模型：GQA/MHA 或混合注意力模型启用会报 KVPP currently supports only non-hybrid MLA models.。
  • 图模式受限：仅支持 eager 或 PIECEWISE；FULL 图启动报错。
  • PD 分离仅在 prefill 节点开启；decode（kv_consumer）节点必须关闭。
  • 连接器受限：PD 时 kv_connector 必须是 MultiConnector（且 connectors 列表非空），且不得为 MooncakeConnectorV2 的 kv_consumer 角色。
  • 派生校验未通过会直接 raise，配置错误不会静默跳过。

docs.title: enable_mlapo
docs.text:
MLAPO（Model Layer-wise Adaptive Parallel Optimization，模型逐层自适应并行优化）。 📚 所属专题：5. PD 分离与并行

属性 值 类型 bool 默认值 true 状态 ✅ active 旧环境变量 VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_MLAPO（"1" → true）

vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B --additional-config='{"enable_mlapo": false}'

docs.title: enable_prefill_mc2
docs.text:
为 prefill 批次预留 MC2 token 容量。 📚 所属专题：1. MoE 通信与计算重叠

属性 值 类型 bool 默认值 false 状态 ✅ active（临时开关）

docs.title: 作用
docs.text:
默认情况下 mc2_token_capacity 按 decode 容量计算。启用本开关后，改用 max_num_batched_tokens 计算，为 prefill 批次预留 MC2 容量。

临时开关

一旦 MC2 算子在所有场景下完备，本开关将被移除且 MC2 默认启用。请勿在长期配置中依赖它。

docs.title: 使用约束
docs.text: 启用本开关时，max_num_batched_tokens 的推荐最大值为 tp_size * 512，超出可能导致容量规划失效。

docs.title: 用法
docs.text:
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B \
  --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 2048 \
  --additional-config='{"enable_prefill_mc2": true}'

docs.title: 部署形态
docs.text:
混部 = PD 共置（colocated）或同机多实例共享 NPU；PD 分离 = P/D 节点经 KV 传输分离部署。「未见官方说明」≠ 不能开，仅表示官方文档未给出专门约束。

维度 结论 混部（colocated） ✅ 可开 PD 分离 ✅ P 节点

语义即「为 prefill batch 预留 mc2_token_capacity」；Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 配方 P 节点开启、D 节点不配。官方注明是临时开关，MC2 算子补全后移除。

docs.title: enable_shared_expert_dp
docs.text:
共享专家权重在 TP rank 间复制、以数据并行方式运行。 📚 所属专题：1. MoE 通信与计算重叠

属性 值 类型 bool 默认值 false 状态 ✅ active 适用 含共享专家的 MoE 模型

docs.title: 作用
docs.text:
启用后，共享专家（shared expert）权重会在各 TP rank 上复制一份，并以数据并行（DP）方式执行，避免共享专家计算成为 TP 通信的串行瓶颈。

  • 收益：共享专家计算吞吐提升；
  • 代价：每 rank 多存一份共享专家权重，显存消耗增加；
  • 与上游 vLLM 的 MoE 序列并行相互独立：两者可单独启用，也可同时启用。

docs.title: 用法
docs.text: vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B --additional-config='{"enable_shared_expert_dp": true}'

docs.title: 部署形态
docs.text:
混部 = PD 共置（colocated）或同机多实例共享 NPU；PD 分离 = P/D 节点经 KV 传输分离部署。「未见官方说明」≠ 不能开，仅表示官方文档未给出专门约束。

维度 结论 混部（colocated） ✅ 可开 PD 分离 ✅ 双端

官方 PD 配方 P/D 两侧均出现；DeepSeek-V4-Pro 说明其作用为把 shared experts 放到 DP ranks。

出处

docs.text:

  • multistream_overlap_gate — 门控多流重叠
  • dynamic_eplb — 专家负载均衡

docs.title: enable_sparse_li_c8
docs.text:
为稀疏注意力（Lightning Indexer）启用 C8 KV cache 布局。⚠️ v0.30.0 起改为派生量，additional-config 传本键不再生效。 📚 所属专题：3. KV Cache 量化与内存格式

属性 值 类型 bool 默认值 false 状态 ❌ removed（v0.30.0 起被派生覆盖） 支持版本 v0.23.0

docs.title: 启用方式对照
docs.text:
版本 写法 v0.23.0 --additional-config '{"enable_sparse_li_c8": true}' v0.30.0 / main --attention_config.indexer_kv_dtype int8（或 fp8）

v0.30.0 起 derive_and_validate 无条件覆盖：

enable_sparse_li_c8 = attention_config.indexer_kv_dtype in ["fp8", "int8"] and use_sparse

即：只要 indexer_kv_dtype 是 fp8/int8 且模型本身是稀疏注意力架构，C8 布局自动启用——不再需要（也不能）用 additional-config 手动开。

docs.title: 联动与互斥
docs.text:
• 与 enable_sparse_li_c4 互斥：indexer_kv_dtype = "mxfp4" 时派生 enable_sparse_li_c4，与 C8 路径互斥（源码有防御性 ValueError）。一个 indexer_kv_dtype 只能取一个值，天然二选一。
  • P/D 两侧 dtype 必须一致：官方教程强调 --kv-cache-dtype 与 --attention_config.indexer_kv_dtype 在 P 和 D 节点要配成同样的值，否则传输的 KV 不能直接复用。

docs.title: 部署形态
docs.text:
混部 = PD 共置（colocated）或同机多实例共享 NPU；PD 分离 = P/D 节点经 KV 传输分离部署。「未见官方说明」≠ 不能开，仅表示官方文档未给出专门约束。

维度 结论 混部（colocated） ◻️ 未见官方说明 PD 分离 ✅ D 节点

GLM5.2 PD 配方中配在 D 节点（kv_consumer）；GLM5 优化表按吞吐场景区分：高吞吐/PD 场景开启、低延迟场景关闭。v0.30.0 起由 --attention_config.indexer_kv_dtype 派生。

出处

docs.title: 相关参数
docs.text:
• --attention-config — indexer_kv_dtype 的宿主参数（v0.30.0 起 C8 的实际开关）
  • --kv-cache-dtype — 全模型 KV 存储 dtype（SFA 模型 C8 由它派生）
  • enable_sparse_li_c4 — mxfp4 路径（派生量）

docs.title: enable_sparse_sfa_c8
docs.text:
为 SFA（Sparse Flash Attention）稀疏注意力启用 C8 KV cache 布局。⚠️ v0.30.0 起改为派生量，additional-config 传本键不再生效。 📚 所属专题：3. KV Cache 量化与内存格式

属性 值 类型 bool 默认值 false 状态 ❌ removed（v0.30.0 起被派生覆盖） 支持版本 v0.23.0

docs.title: 启用方式对照
docs.text:
版本 写法 v0.23.0 --additional-config '{"enable_sparse_sfa_c8": true}' v0.30.0 / main --kv-cache-dtype int8（或 fp8）

v0.30.0 起 derive_and_validate 无条件覆盖：

enable_sparse_sfa_c8 = cache_config.cache_dtype in ["fp8", "int8"] and use_sparse_sfa

即：SFA 稀疏注意力模型只要 --kv-cache-dtype 是 fp8/int8，SFA-C8 布局自动启用。

docs.title: 联动
docs.text:
• 官方 GLM5 / GLM5.2 教程实测写法：--kv-cache-dtype fp8 --attention_config.indexer_kv_dtype fp8 成对出现——SFA 模型的 KV dtype 跟 --kv-cache-dtype，Lightning Indexer 稀疏层的 KV dtype 跟 indexer_kv_dtype。
  • P/D 两侧取值必须一致，否则 KV 传输后不能直接复用。

docs.title: eplb_config
docs.text:
EPLB（Expert Parallelism Load Balancer，专家并行负载均衡）的完整配置入口。 📚 所属专题：2. 负载均衡与调度

属性 值 类型 dict 默认值 {} 状态 ✅ active 适用 MoE 模型；A2（num_redundant_experts 必须为 0）/ A3

docs.title: 三种模式总览
docs.text:
模式 关键子键 说明 详情 动态 EPLB dynamic_eplb: true 运行时自动均衡专家热点 dynamic_eplb 录制 expert_map_record_path 录制专家映射供后续静态加载 dynamic_eplb 静态 EPLB expert_map_path 加载预录制映射，无运行时开销 本文「静态模式」

动态与录制模式还需环境变量 DYNAMIC_EPLB=true（或 EXPERT_MAP_RECORD=true）作为安全防护。

docs.title: 子键速查
docs.text: 子键 类型 默认值 说明 dynamic_eplb bool false 开启动态均衡 expert_map_path str — 静态映射文件路径 expert_map_record_path str — 录制输出路径 expert_heat_collection_interval int 600 热度收集间隔 algorithm_execution_interval int 50 均衡算法执行间隔 eplb_policy_type int 2 策略类型（当前推荐 2 = SwiftBalanceEplb） num_redundant_experts int 0 冗余专家数；A2 上必须为 0 eplb_heat_collection_stage str "all" 热度统计阶段：all / prefill / decode

docs.title: 静态模式用法
docs.text:
# 先用录制模式生成映射（需 DYNAMIC_EPLB=true 或 EXPERT_MAP_RECORD=true）
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B \
  --additional-config='{"eplb_config": {"expert_map_record_path": "/data/expert_map.json"}}'

# 再用静态模式加载（无需环境变量，适合生产）
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B \
  --additional-config='{"eplb_config": {"expert_map_path": "/data/expert_map.json"}}'

docs.title: 互斥
docs.text: • enable_force_eplb 与 eplb_config.dynamic_eplb 互斥，同时设置启动报错。

docs.title: finegrained_tp_config
docs.text:
细粒度张量并行（Fine-Grained Tensor Parallelism）配置。 📚 所属专题：5. PD 分离与并行

属性 值 类型 dict 默认值 {} 状态 ✅ active

docs.title: 说明
docs.text: 将模型按模块（如 MLP、attention、embedding、LM Head）设置不同的 TP 并行粒度，替代全局统一的 TP size。相关字段（如 embedding_tensor_parallel_size、mlp_tensor_parallel_size、oproj_tensor_parallel_size 等）在 v0.23 起逐步收归到本配置下。

docs.title: 兼容性
docs.text:
• embedding / LM Head 的细粒度 TP 与 enable_pcp_embedding_lmhead_weight_sharding 不兼容（PCP size > 1 时二选一）。

具体字段清单以对应版本的官方文档为准。

docs.title: kv_pool_range_debug
docs.text:
KV pool 逐层范围传输审计日志。调试 KV cache 管理问题的工具开关。 📚 所属专题：6. KV 复用与池化

docs.title: mc2_comm_alg
docs.text:
dispatch/combine 算子的通信算法选择（v0.30.0 新增），用于取代已弃用的 enable_mc2_hierarchy_comm。 📚 所属专题：1. MoE 通信与计算重叠

属性 值 类型 str 默认值 "" 状态 ✅ active（v0.30.0 新增） 适用 MoE 模型；A2 / A3

docs.title: 取值
docs.text: 值 含义 芯片支持 "" 默认算法 全部 "fullmesh" 全互联算法 全部 "hierarchy" 层次化算法（跨节点 ROCE） 仅 A2 / A3 "fullmesh_v2" 全互联算法 v2 目前仅 A3

docs.title: 用法
docs.text:
# 跨节点 MoE 通信走层次化算法
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B --additional-config='{"mc2_comm_alg": "hierarchy"}'

docs.title: 与旧开关的关系
docs.text:
旧写法（deprecated） 新写法 {"enable_mc2_hierarchy_comm": true} {"mc2_comm_alg": "hierarchy"}

源码中设置 mc2_comm_alg = "hierarchy" 会自动等效旧的 hierarchy 行为；两者同时设置时以 mc2_comm_alg 为准。

docs.title: mega_moe_max_tokens
docs.text:
融合 MC2/MegaMoe 路径中 dispatch 后每个 rank 的 token 容量参考值。 📚 所属专题：1. MoE 通信与计算重叠

属性 值 类型 int 默认值 65536 状态 ✅ active 适用 MoE 模型 + enable_fused_mc2 融合路径

docs.title: 作用
docs.text:
该值同时作为：

  • dispatch_ffn_combine 算子的 max_output_size；
  • CANN MegaMoe 缓冲区的 max_recv_token_num。

docs.title: 风险
docs.text:
超容量精度下降

若某个 rank 的实际 MoE 负载超过该值，可能出现精度下降。绝对安全上限为：

num_max_tokens_per_rank * ep_world_size * min(num_topk, expert_per_rank)

但直接使用安全上限会消耗非常大的设备内存，应按实际 expert 负载分布调整。

docs.title: 用法
docs.text:
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B \
  --additional-config='{"enable_fused_mc2": 2, "mega_moe_max_tokens": 32768}'

docs.title: mix_placement
docs.text:
混合放置模式（DP×TP 平面上的专家/权重放置策略），计入 RFork 权重传输的兼容性指纹。 📚 所属专题：1. MoE 通信与计算重叠

属性 值 类型 bool 默认值 false 状态 ✅ active 适用 MoE 模型 + RFork 权重传输场景

docs.title: 用法
docs.text:
vllm serve <model> \
  --additional-config='{"mix_placement": true}'

docs.title: 注意事项
docs.text:
• 必须收发两端一致：mix_placement 是 RFork 兼容性指纹的组成部分，发送端与接收端配置不一致会导致指纹不匹配、权重传输失败。
  • 影响 MoE 专家在 DP×TP 平面上的放置布局，与 finegrained_tp_config、enable_shared_expert_dp 等分片策略相关。
  • 正常在线推理无需显式设置；仅在使用 RFork 热迁移/重放权重时需要关注。

docs.title: mlapo_keep_prefill_weights
docs.text:
MLAPO 场景下，D 节点是否保留 prefill 权重。 📚 所属专题：5. PD 分离与并行

属性 值 类型 bool 默认值 false 状态 ✅ active（v0.30.0 新增） 依赖 enable_mlapo

docs.title: 背景
docs.text: MLAPO 默认在 kv_consumer（仅 decode 的 D 节点）上释放 prefill 权重以节省显存。但 D 节点存在正常的本地 prefill 路径（recompute / fallback / preempt），权重释放后这些路径会崩溃（issue #11882）。

docs.title: 作用
docs.text:
启用后，D 节点保留 prefill 权重在 NPU 上：

  • 收益：本地 prefill 路径稳定，不会崩溃；
  • 代价：D 节点显存占用增加。

docs.title: 使用建议
docs.text: PD 分离 + MLAPO 部署，且 D 节点观察到过 prefill fallback / preempt 时，建议开启。

docs.title: 用法
docs.text:
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B \
  --additional-config='{"enable_mlapo": true, "mlapo_keep_prefill_weights": true}'

docs.title: 部署形态
docs.text:
混部 = PD 共置（colocated）或同机多实例共享 NPU；PD 分离 = P/D 节点经 KV 传输分离部署。「未见官方说明」≠ 不能开，仅表示官方文档未给出专门约束。

维度 结论 混部（colocated） — 不适用 PD 分离 ✅ D 节点

官方配置文档：在 kv_consumer（decode-only D）节点上保留 MLAPO prefill 权重——D 节点的本地 prefill 路径（recompute/fallback/preempt）在权重释放后会崩溃（issue #11882）；以显存换稳定。

出处

  • recompute_scheduler_enable — D 节点重计算调度

docs.title: multistream_engram_overlap
docs.text:
Engram 模块多流重叠，把 Engram 子模块的计算与通信分配到多条 NPU 流并行执行。 📚 所属专题：1. MoE 通信与计算重叠

docs.title: 用法
docs.text:
vllm serve deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1 \
  --additional-config='{"multistream_engram_overlap": false}'  # 显式关闭 A5 默认开启的重叠

docs.title: 注意事项
docs.text:
• 默认策略因硬件而异：仅 A5（FP8 优化设备家族）默认开启；显式设置会覆盖默认策略。
  • FULL 图需在消费者侧等待描述符相关的外部事件，与 multistream_dsv4_dsa_overlap 等图捕获行为叠加时需注意调度顺序。
  • 仅 Engram 模型（如 DeepSeek V4.1）有该模块，其他模型开启无效果。

docs.title: 作用

docs.title: recompute_scheduler_enable
docs.text:
重计算调度器：PD 分离架构 D 节点上的显存节省方案。 📚 所属专题：2. 负载均衡与调度

!!! warning \"顶层键已废弃\" v0.30.0 起该顶层键迁移至 scheduler_config.<key>，直接设置顶层键会收到 deprecation 警告。官方文档写法见 scheduler_config。

属性 值 类型 bool 默认值 false 状态 ✅ active（顶层键已弃用，请用 scheduler_config.recompute_scheduler_enable）

节点类型限制

仅在 PD 分离的 D 节点（kv_role = kv_consumer，仅 decode）上有效。在 P 节点或 PD-mixed 模式下启用，启动时会报明确错误并失败。

docs.title: 作用
docs.text: D 节点本地 prefill 路径（recompute / fallback / preempt）触发时，通过重计算调度策略降低 KV cache 与激活的显存占用，换取更长上下文或更大批次的承载能力。

docs.title: 推荐用法（v0.30.0+ 规范层级）
docs.text:
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B \
  --additional-config='{"scheduler_config": {"recompute_scheduler_enable": true}}'

docs.title: 迁移
docs.text:
迁移前 迁移后 {"recompute_scheduler_enable": true}（顶层键） {"scheduler_config": {"recompute_scheduler_enable": true}}

顶层键过渡期仍兼容，与 scheduler_config 同时提供时以后者为准。

docs.text:

docs.title: rl_config
docs.text:
一键 RL 模式总开关（v0.30.0 新增）。为 RLHF/训练-推理一体场景自动套用一组经过验证的固定行为。 📚 所属专题：9. 训练与 RL

属性 值 类型 dict 默认值 {} 状态 ✅ active（v0.30.0 新增）

docs.title: 子键
docs.text: 子键 类型 默认值 说明 enabled bool false RL 模式总开关；false 时其余子键全部忽略 sleep_mode_extra_cleanup bool false sleep 期间释放 HCCL 进程组 + 清理 ACL 图工作区，把更多 NPU 内存还给训练器，代价是唤醒延迟增加 enable_training_consistency bool false 启用训练-推理一致性 FA3 注意力后端；需要 flash_attn_npu_v3 包 enable_batch_invariant bool false 工作进程启动前设置 VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1（批次不变确定性计算）

docs.title: 启用时的固定行为（不可通过子键修改）
docs.text:
rl_config.enabled = true 时，vLLM-Ascend 每次初始化都会强制执行：

  1. 刷新全局 Ascend 配置（等效 refresh: true）；
  2. 强制 weight_nz_mode = 0（优先于顶层 weight_nz_mode 配置）；
  3. 设置 VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE=1；
  4. 从 PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF 中移除 expandable_segments 条目。

docs.title: 批次不变性细节
docs.text:
enable_batch_invariant = true 时，工作进程侧的批次不变初始化会设置 HCCL_DETERMINISTIC=strict 和 LCCL_DETERMINISTIC=1。注意：

  • 需要 COMPILE_CUSTOM_KERNELS=1 从源码构建 vllm-ascend；
  • RL 模式已强制 weight_nz_mode=0，两者配合是批次不变的前提。

docs.title: 用法
docs.text:
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B \
  --additional-config='{"rl_config": {"enabled": true, "sleep_mode_extra_cleanup": true}}'

docs.title: Runtime Guard 配置三件套
docs.text:
运行时守护（Runtime Guard）的启动配置入口。 📚 所属专题：8. 稳定性与监控：Runtime Guard

配置键 类型 默认值 说明 runtime_config_path str None Runtime Guard JSON 配置路径，默认 /runtime/config/runtime_config.json runtime_config dict None 启动时叠加层，与运行时配置默认值合并（检测器、dump 配额、报告标志） runtime_config_hot_reload bool false 启用 runtime_config.json 热重载（仅启动时生效；不是 JSON 字段）

docs.title: 说明
docs.text:
Runtime Guard 是 vLLM-Ascend 的运行时检测与保护机制。三者关系：

  1. runtime_config_path 指定 JSON 配置文件位置；
  2. runtime_config 以字典形式提供与文件合并的叠加配置（适合不便落盘的部署）；
  3. runtime_config_hot_reload 允许运行期重载上述 JSON。

具体检测器与配额字段以对应版本的 Runtime Guard 特性文档为准。

docs.title: scheduler_config
docs.text:
Ascend 调度器扩展配置的规范层级（v0.30.0 新增）。均衡调度、重计算调度、DyntraLB、ShortRequestFirst、动态分块流水线并行等开关的统一入口。 📚 所属专题：2. 负载均衡与调度

属性 值 类型 dict 默认值 {} 状态 ✅ active（v0.30.0 新增）

docs.title: 子键
docs.text: 子键 类型 默认值 说明 详情页 enable_balance_scheduling bool false 均衡调度 enable_balance_scheduling recompute_scheduler_enable bool false 重计算调度器（仅 PD 分离 D 节点） recompute_scheduler_enable short_request_first_config dict {} ShortRequestFirst prefill 调度 short_request_first_config profiling_chunk_config dict {} 动态分块流水线并行 profiling_chunk_config batch_job_sched_config dict {} batch-job-aware 调度 batch_job_sched_config dyntra_lb_config dict {} PD 分离 D 节点负载均衡 dyntra_lb_config

docs.title: 用法
docs.text:
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B \
  --additional-config='{"scheduler_config": {"enable_balance_scheduling": true, "recompute_scheduler_enable": false}}'

docs.title: 迁移背景
docs.text:
PR #9064 迁移期，以下顶层键仍兼容但已弃用，未来版本移除：

  • enable_balance_scheduling
  • recompute_scheduler_enable
  • short_request_first_config
  • profiling_chunk_config

优先级

过渡期若同一字段顶层键与 scheduler_config 都提供，以 scheduler_config 内的值为准。

docs.title: short_request_first_config
docs.text:
ShortRequestFirst：短请求优先的 prefill 调度策略。 📚 所属专题：2. 负载均衡与调度

!!! warning \"顶层键已废弃\" v0.30.0 起该顶层键迁移至 scheduler_config.<key>，直接设置顶层键会收到 deprecation 警告。官方文档写法见 scheduler_config。

属性 值 类型 dict 默认值 {} 状态 ✅ active（v0.30.0 新增） 嵌套位置 scheduler_config.short_request_first_config

docs.title: 适用场景
docs.text: FCFS 同步/异步、PD-prefill（P 节点）或 PD-mixed 节点上的 prefill 调度：将短请求优先调度，降低短请求的排队延迟，改善 TTFT 分布。

docs.title: 迁移
docs.text:

vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B \
  --additional-config='{"scheduler_config": {"short_request_first_config": {}}}'

docs.title: sparse_kv_offload_config
docs.text:
稀疏 KV cache 卸载到 DRAM 的配置，把长上下文的冷 KV 块搬出 HBM，扩大可并发 token 数。 📚 所属专题：3. KV Cache 量化与内存格式

属性 值 类型 dict 默认值 {} 状态 ✅ active 适用 仅 950 系列产品（A5）

docs.title: 用法
docs.text:
vllm serve <model> \
  --additional-config='{"sparse_kv_offload_config": {"enabled": true, "dram_size_per_dp_GB": 110}}' \
  --kv-transfer-config='{"kv_connector": "SfaRemoteD2HConnector", "kv_role": "kv_consumer", "kv_port": 20050}'

docs.title: 子键
docs.text: 键 类型 默认 说明 enabled bool false 是否启用稀疏 KV 卸载 topk_buffer_size int -1 -1 时自动解析为 (1 + 投机 token 数) × 2048 dram_size_per_dp_GB int 110 每 DP 的 DRAM 容量上限（GB） keep_device_kv_cache bool false 是否同时保留 HBM 中的 KV cache use_fused_overlap bool false 是否启用融合 overlap 路径（false 时走 fused LIM + Copy-SFA）

docs.title: 注意事项
docs.text:
• 仅 950 系列产品（A5）：from_additional_config 里有 is_950() 前置校验，其他芯片会启动报错。
  • 勿在 prefill 节点设置：kv_consumer（decode 侧）专属，prefill 节点配置无意义且可能报错。
  • dram_size_per_dp_GB 必须为正，否则 sparse_kv_offload_config.dram_size_per_dp_GB must be positive。
  • 需搭配 SfaRemoteD2HConnector / AscendStoreConnector 等 KV 传输连接器使用。

维度 结论 混部（colocated） ◻️ 未见官方说明 PD 分离 ✅ D 节点

官方分层/稀疏 KV 卸载指南：「Do not set sparse_kv_offload_config on Prefill」；D 节点用独立 host pool，配置与 P 侧不同；与 PreemptOffloadConnector 互斥（含 MultiConnector 包装）。

出处

docs.title: weight_nz_mode
docs.text:
权重 NZ（FractalNZ）格式模式。量化模型推理性能的重要开关。 📚 所属专题：3. KV Cache 量化与内存格式

属性 值 类型 int 默认值 1 状态 ✅ active 旧环境变量 VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_NZ（注意：键名已更改）

docs.title: 取值
docs.text: 值 含义 0 禁用 NZ 1 仅对量化权重启用 NZ（默认） 2 在支持的情况下，对 BF16/FP16 权重也启用 NZ

docs.title: 用法
docs.text: vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B --additional-config='{"weight_nz_mode": 2}'

docs.title: 注意事项
docs.text:
• 迁移时键名不同：旧环境变量名为 VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_NZ，迁移后键名为 weight_nz_mode，且语义从"是否启用"扩展为三档模式。
  • RL 模式强制覆盖：启用 rl_config 时，NZ 会被强制设为 0（RL 模式的固定行为优先于顶层 weight_nz_mode）。
  • NZ 对矩阵乘类算子的性能影响显著，调整该开关后建议对比首 token 延迟与吞吐。

docs.text:
Xlite 图模式配置。 📚 所属专题：4. 图与编译

属性 值 类型 dict 默认值 {} 状态 ✅ active

docs.title: 说明
docs.text:
Xlite 图模式的参数入口，控制模型在 Xlite 图执行路径下的行为。属于进阶优化项，一般在与官方调优指南对应的场景下使用。

docs.title: vLLM-Ascend Feature Flag Handbook
docs.text:
A community-maintained deep reference of vLLM-Ascend feature flags:

--additional-config keys ｜ Environment variables ｜ Migration ｜ Version history

docs.title: What is this?
docs.text:
vLLM-Ascend controls a large set of experimental, scenario-specific optimizations via feature flags: fused MoE operators (MC2), dynamic EPLB, weight NZ layout, balance scheduling, RL mode, and more.

The official docs scatter these flags across several pages in the form of terse tables. This handbook aims to be:

  1. Complete: every --additional-config key and every active environment variable;
  2. Searchable: one overview table plus per-flag pages;
  3. Traceable: introduction version, migration status (PR #9064 env-var migration), applicable hardware;
  4. Machine-readable: docs/flags.json for scripts and tools.

Relationship with official docs

This handbook is a community supplement, not a replacement for the official documentation. When in doubt, trust the official docs — and please open an issue here so we can fix the handbook.

docs.title: Contributing
docs.text: The data source lives in data/flags/ as YAML files. Fixing a default, adding a risk note, or documenting a new flag are all welcome contributions. See Contributing.

docs.title: Ascend Configuration Entry Points
docs.text: vLLM-Ascend configuration lives in more places than --additional-config. This page is the map of all 6 entry points: what each is, who reads it, typical keys, and the traps — with links to the deep-dives.

docs.title: Entry-point map
docs.text:
# Entry point Form Read by Deep dive 1 Top-level vLLM CLI args --key val vLLM engine (cross-platform) Engine args overview 2 --additional-config JSON '{"key": val}' Ascend plugin (AscendConfig) Feature flags overview 3 Ascend patches to CLI value domains Ascend-only values of #1 args Ascend platform patches §3 below 4 Connector fields inside --kv-transfer-config nested JSON Ascend connector implementations kv-transfer-config page 5 Environment variables export X=y build scripts / runtime Environment variables 6 runtime_config.json file JSON(C) file Runtime Guard §6 below

The six entries are not disjoint: one arg can be both #1 and #3 (a patch widened its value domain), and runtime_config's startup keys go through #2 while its content lives in the #6 file. Crossings are flagged below.

docs.title: 1. Top-level vLLM CLI args (cross-platform engine args)
docs.text:
vllm serve --max-num-seqs 256 --kv-cache-dtype fp8 ... — args defined by upstream vLLM, shared across CUDA/ROCm/NPU, validated and consumed by the vLLM engine itself.

  • The handbook covers 78: each evidenced in official vLLM-Ascend tutorial command lines and defined in the vLLM source CLI.
  • Note: some arg values are re-consumed by the Ascend plugin to derive #2 flags (see the kv-cache-dtype page) — hence the cross-links between the two overviews.
  • Canonical example: --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_DECODE_ONLY"}' — the mainstream official recipe for graphing decode only on PD-disaggregated D nodes. Deep dive: compilation-config detail page.

docs.title: 2. --additional-config JSON (AscendConfig feature flags)
docs.text:
vllm serve --additional-config '{"enable_kvpp": true, "eplb_config": {...}}' — the Ascend plugin's own config keys, defined in AscendConfig (vllm_ascend/ascend_config.py), Ascend-only, pydantic-validated (extra="forbid" — a typo'd key fails startup).

  • The handbook covers 64, organized by status (active/deprecated/removed/planned) and version support (v0.23.0/v0.30.0/main).
  • The three Runtime Guard startup keys (runtime_config / runtime_config_path / runtime_config_hot_reload) also go here, but their content lives in the #6 file.

docs.title: 3. Ascend patches to CLI value domains
docs.text:
The easiest category to miss: vLLM-Ascend adds no CLI args of its own — instead it widens the accepted values of existing args (vllm_ascend/patch/platform/, applied at platform activation).

Arg Upstream values Ascend patch adds Purpose --kv-cache-dtype auto / fp8 / fp8_e5m2 / bf16 / fp16 … int8, mxfp8 int8: KV cache of DeepSeek V4-style sparse MLA models; mxfp8: C8-MXFP layout (FP8 KV + E8M0 scales) on the A5 QFA path --attention_config.indexer_kv_dtype auto / bf16 / fp8 / mxfp4 / nvfp4 int8 DeepSeek V4's indexer K cache

Trap: reading vLLM's official docs alone, you'd never know these values are legal — validation lives in the patch-rebuilt pydantic Literal. The --kv-cache-dtype int8 --attention_config.indexer_kv_dtype int8 pair in the official GLM5/5.2 tutorials is the evidence.

Details: kv-cache-dtype page, enable_sparse_li_c8, enable_sparse_sfa_c8.

docs.title: 4. Connector fields inside --kv-transfer-config
docs.text:
The KV transfer config itself is a #1 CLI arg, but the connector fields inside its value are Ascend implementations:

  • AscendStoreConnector: backend (mooncake/memcache/yuanrong), use_layerwise, lookup_rpc_port — the KV pooling entry
  • MooncakeConnectorV2: use_ascend_direct, prefill/decode topology declarations
  • MultiConnector: composes multiple connectors (P2P transfer + pooling write)

Field-by-field anatomy: the "KV pooling" section of the kv-transfer-config page.

docs.title: 5. Environment variables
docs.text:
Two families:

  • Runtime: VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_BATCH_MEMCPY (no additional-config equivalent — env-only), DYNAMIC_EPLB, EXPERT_MAP_RECORD
  • Build-time: COMPILE_CUSTOM_KERNELS, MAX_JOBS, SOC_VERSION, ASCEND_HOME_PATH, HCCL_SO_PATH, etc.

Full list: Environment variables. Rule of thumb: if a config has an additional-config key, don't use the env var; env vars only cover key-less switches and build behavior.

docs.title: 6. runtime_config.json (Runtime Guard)
docs.text:
vLLM-Ascend's online anomaly detection and incident-response layer: it watches decode-time signals (token repetition, garbled output, non-finite logits, speculative acceptance drift and more), writes structured reports under runtime/report/ on trigger, and can optionally capture per-request KV cache blocks (dump_kv).

  • Content via file: defaults to <cwd>/runtime/config/runtime_config.json, JSONC comments OK; top-level keys actions / dump / ascend_log / report / detector
  • Startup keys via #2: runtime_config_path (relocate), runtime_config_hot_reload (startup hot-reload), runtime_config (startup overlay — overwrites any pre-existing file; start first then edit the live file, or put everything in the overlay)
  • Default deployment keeps detectors off and hot-reload off — negligible overhead

Official docs: Runtime Guard · runtime_config JSON schema. Related flags: runtime_config, runtime_config_path, runtime_config_hot_reload.

docs.title: Which entry should I use
docs.text: What you want to configure Entry point Concurrency, parallelism, memory, quantization (generic behavior) #1 CLI args Ascend-only features (KVPP, EPLB, RL mode…) #2 additional-config Sparse-model KV dtype values (int8/mxfp8) #1 + #3 (patched domains) PD disaggregation / KV pooling transport #1's --kv-transfer-config + #4 connector fields Key-less build/runtime switches #5 env vars Online quality monitoring & incident dumps #6 runtime_config.json

docs.title: Repository layout
docs.text:
├── data/flags/            # Single source of truth: one YAML per flag
├── docs/                  # MkDocs sources
│   └── flags/             # Per-flag detail pages (auto-stubbed when missing)
├── scripts/generate_tables.py   # Renders overview tables + stubs + flags.json
├── docs/flags.json        # Machine-readable export (auto-generated, do not edit)
└── mkdocs.yml

docs.title: Adding a flag
docs.text:
1. Create data/flags/<key>.yaml with the required fields:
key: enable_xxx
type: bool            # bool | int | float | str | dict | list
default: false
status: active        # active | deprecated | removed | planned
version_support:      # per-version support (true/false)
  v0.23.0: false
  v0.30.0: true
  main: true
desc:
  zh: 一句话中文说明。
  en: One-line English description.

Common optional fields: legacy_env, hardware, models, requires / conflicts, values, version_note (bilingual), source.

  1. Run the generator:
pip install -r requirements.txt
python scripts/generate_tables.py

It validates the YAML, updates the overview table, stubs missing detail pages, and exports flags.json.

  1. (Recommended) Replace the stub docs/flags/<key>.md with a full page: rationale, usage, applicable scenarios, risks, interactions.
  2. Open a PR. CI regenerates and validates everything.

docs.title: Updating a flag
docs.text:
• Defaults / status / migration info: edit only data/flags/*.yaml. Never hand-edit the overview table (it is regenerated).
  • Detail page prose: edit the matching docs/flags/*.md.
  • Commit the regenerated docs/flags.json and docs/includes changes — CI enforces this via git diff --exit-code.

docs.title: Content guidelines
docs.text:
1. Accuracy first: defaults, status and hardware support must be verifiable (official docs, source code, release notes). Cite the source in the YAML source field.
  2. Official docs win conflicts: if this handbook disagrees with the official docs, open an issue here.
  3. Surface risks explicitly: flags that break accuracy, are profiling-only, or carry memory costs must use a !!! warning admonition.
  4. Bilingual: YAML desc needs both zh and en. Detail pages may start Chinese-first; English translations welcome.

docs.title: Local preview
docs.text:
mkdocs serve

Then open http://127.0.0.1:8000.

docs.title: Environment Variables
docs.text: Besides the 10+ flags being migrated (see migration table), the following environment variables remain active standalone entry points with no announced migration plan.

docs.title: Runtime environment variables
docs.text: Env var Type Default Description VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_BATCH_MEMCPY "1" / "0" / unset unset (auto) Controls the aclrtMemcpyBatchAsync compile path for KV cache offloading. "1" force-enables, "0" force-disables, unset auto-detects from CANN headers. Note: no --additional-config key exists; env var only. DYNAMIC_EPLB "true" / "false" "false" Safety guard for dynamic EPLB. Only takes effect when dynamic_eplb: true (or record mode) is also set in config. See dynamic_eplb EXPERT_MAP_RECORD bool unset EPLB record mode: records the expert map and saves it to expert_map_record_path HCCL_SO_PATH path unset (libhccl.so) HCCL library path used by the pyhccl communicator backend. Only needed when explicitly using the pyhccl backend

docs.title: Deployment form
docs.text:
Colocated = PD on the same instance or multiple instances sharing NPUs; PD-disaggregated = P/D nodes split via KV transfer. None of the three runtime env vars has documented deployment-form restrictions — set them uniformly per node; "no official guidance" ≠ cannot enable.

Env var Colocated PD-disaggregated VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_BATCH_MEMCPY no official guidance no official guidance DYNAMIC_EPLB no official guidance no official guidance EXPERT_MAP_RECORD no official guidance no official guidance

For per-flag deployment conclusions (with official sources), see the "部署形态" section of each feature flag page.

docs.title: Build-time environment variables
docs.text:
These affect source builds only, not runtime behavior. Full list: official build docs.

Env var Default Description COMPILE_CUSTOM_KERNELS 1 Whether to compile custom kernels. Set 0 when running unit tests without an NPU MAX_JOBS CPU core count Build parallelism SOC_VERSION auto-detect Chip version, auto-queried via npu-smi during build ASCEND_HOME_PATH /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/latest CANN toolkit path VERBOSE "0" Verbose logs during compilation; set 1 for more build output CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release CMake build type: Release / Debug / RelWithDebugInfo C_COMPILER system default C compiler path (when building custom kernels from source) CXX_COMPILER system default C++ compiler path (same as above) VLLM_VERSION unset Version override for source-installed vLLM: a locally source-built vLLM often reports a version different from PyPI; set this so vllm-ascend's dependency resolution pins the correct one (developer scenario)

docs.title: Recommendations
docs.text:
• Prefer --additional-config for deployment: except the "Runtime environment variables" above, new configs should use config keys. See Quick start.
  • Do not mix both forms for one flag: when a flag is set both as an env var and as a config key, behavior follows the source implementation (config key usually wins), and mixing makes troubleshooting harder.

docs.title: Feature Topics
docs.text: This page groups all 64 feature flags into 9 topics by the problem they solve. Each topic opens with the principle (what it is, what problem it solves), followed by a member table (one-liner + when to enable). For single-parameter lookup use the feature flags overview; for depth, each flag's detail page.

docs.title: 1. MoE Communication & Compute Overlap
docs.text:
Every MoE layer runs two collective communications: dispatch routes tokens to experts, combine gathers results back. Communication grows linearly with EP size and can dominate compute. The flags here do three things: fuse (merge dispatch/combine into one operator), overlap (hide communication behind compute on extra streams), and quantize (shrink communication bytes). MoE-only (DeepSeek/GLM/Kimi class) — no effect on dense models.

Flag One-liner When to enable enable_fused_mc2 Fused MC2 dispatch/combine operator (0 off / 1 on / 2 MegaMoE) On per official model recipes; A5 MegaMoE requires SiTU models mc2_comm_alg dispatch/combine communication algorithm (fullmesh/hierarchy/fullmesh_v2) Cross-node MoE, per chip: hierarchy A2/A3 only, fullmesh_v2 A3 only combine_quant_mode Combine communication quantization (e.g. 4 = FP8) Cross-node combine bandwidth bottleneck, per official recipes (DeepSeek-V4 D node) enable_shared_expert_dp Run shared experts data-parallel across TP ranks TP>1 with high shared-expert share; trades memory for performance multistream_overlap_shared_expert Overlap shared-expert compute and communication on a dedicated stream MoE with shared experts; when TP=1 or shared_expert_dp is on multistream_dsv4_dsa_overlap DSA multi-stream overlap for DeepSeek V4 On by default; applies to DSV4 models multistream_engram_overlap Engram module multi-stream overlap A5-only by default; explicit value overrides enable_flashcomm1 FlashComm1 communication optimization for SP MoE Model Runner V1 only; use PCP on MRv2 enable_prefill_mc2 Reserve MC2 token capacity for prefill batches P node (PD-disaggregated); officially a temporary switch mix_placement Mixed expert placement on the DP×TP plane Sender and receiver configs must match (RFork weight-transfer fingerprint) ~~enable_mc2_hierarchy_comm~~ Deprecated Use mc2_comm_alg="hierarchy" instead ~~enable_matmul_allreduce~~ / ~~enable_flashcomm2_parallel_size~~ / ~~multistream_overlap_gate~~ Removed See detail pages / version history

docs.title: 2. Load Balancing & Scheduling
docs.text:
EP's pain is routing imbalance: hot experts queue while cold ones idle. This family covers four layers: EP weight balancing (EPLB), PD-disaggregated scheduling (recompute/balance/short-request-first), batch-job scenarios, and RL sampling. Many are mutually exclusive — startup validates combinations and fails loudly on illegal ones.

Flag One-liner When to enable eplb_config EPLB balancing config (dynamic_eplb / expert_map_record sub-keys) Standard concern for EP deployments; dynamic balancing also needs DYNAMIC_EPLB=true enable_force_eplb Force deterministic round-robin expert routing Performance analysis only — replaces real routing and invalidates outputs; never production scheduler_config Canonical aggregation layer for scheduling extensions Since v0.30.0 all scheduling keys are unified here recompute_scheduler_enable Recompute scheduling (recompute instead of storing KV on refill) PD-disaggregated D nodes only — startup error on P / mixed dyntra_lb_config DyntraLB dynamic load balancing PD-disaggregated D nodes only, DP>1; never on P enable_balance_scheduling Balanced scheduling PD-mixed only (A3 single-node / colocated) short_request_first_config Short-request-first prefill scheduling Ordinary / PD-mixed / P node; not supported on D nodes batch_job_sched_config Batch-job-aware scheduling Batch workloads; cannot combine with ShortRequestFirst ~~old top-level keys~~ Merged into scheduler_config since v0.30.0 Old keys still work in transition but warn

Official guides: DyntraLB · ShortRequestFirst · Dynamic chunked pipeline

docs.title: 3. KV Cache Quantization & Memory Formats
docs.text:
KV cache is the #1 memory consumer in long-context serving. This family governs layout (NZ / T-major / per-block transpose), quantization (C8 sparse layouts, int8/mxfp8 — the latter via CLI value-domain patches), and offloading (sparse KV to DRAM) — cutting KV memory with no (or minimal) precision loss.

Flag One-liner When to enable weight_nz_mode Weight NZ format (0 off / 1 quantized only / 2 incl. BF16/FP16) Follow official model recipes per weight format enable_kv_nz NZ layout for KV cache MLA models only (DeepSeek class) enable_transpose_kv_cache_by_block Per-block transposed KV cache (fused-op path) On by default; required by fused attention path sparse_kv_offload_config Offload sparse KV cache to DRAM Never on Prefill (official); D node per memory pressure ~~enable_sparse_li_c8~~ / ~~enable_sparse_sfa_c8~~ Removed Since v0.30.0 derived from --attention_config.indexer_kv_dtype / --kv-cache-dtype ∈ ~~c8_enable_reshape_optim~~ / ~~hamming_sparse~~ Removed See version history

Related engine arg: kv-cache-dtype value patches (int8/mxfp8)

docs.title: 4. Graphs & Compilation
docs.text:
Graph capture freezes a whole forward step into one replay, eliminating kernel-launch and CPU-scheduling overhead — decode steps (1 token per sequence) benefit most. The family splits into two layers: vLLM layer (--compilation-config, cross-platform) and Ascend platform layer (these flags: ACLGraph/Xlite and operator fusion). The platform layer arbitrates the final mode — don't let the two layers fight.

Flag One-liner When to enable ascend_compilation_config Ascend graph compilation config (enable_npugraph_ex etc.) Official PD recipes enable npugraph_ex on D; P often runs eager xlite_graph_config Xlite graph mode (full_mode controls prefill capture) Supported models per official graph_mode guide ascend_fusion_config Fused-operator config (GmmSwigluQuant etc.) Per model recipes; most sub-keys default on ascend_warmup_config Startup warmup overlapping weight loading Large models to cut startup time

Related engine arg: --compilation-config (all cudagraph_mode values) · official graph_mode guide

docs.title: 5. PD Disaggregation & Parallelism
docs.text:
PD disaggregation splits prefill (compute-bound) from decode (bandwidth/memory-bound) onto separate nodes that scale independently. This family covers long-context parallelism forms (PCP for prefill / DCP for decode), fine-grained TP (memory for concurrency on D), MLAPO layer-wise parallelism, and CPU binding.

Flag One-liner When to enable enable_pcp_embedding_lmhead_weight_sharding Shard Embedding/LMHead weights within PCP groups Default on when PCP>1 enable_pcp_o_proj_weight_sharding Shard O-projection weights within PCP groups Default on when PCP>1 finegrained_tp_config Fine-grained TP (independent TP degrees for oproj/mlp/lmhead/embedding) PD-disaggregated D nodes only (oproj/mlp>1 startup-validated), with recompute scheduling + preempt offload enable_mlapo MLAPO layer-wise adaptive parallelism Decode nodes only in PD (official); consumes more memory mlapo_keep_prefill_weights Keep prefill weights on D nodes instead of freeing D-node local-prefill paths need it (issue #11882); memory for stability enable_cpu_binding Ascend CPU binding on ARM servers Widely enabled on both sides in official PD recipes profiling_chunk_config Dynamic chunked pipeline parallelism Requires PP>1; GLM5.2 evidences P node; incompatible with DyntraLB/balanced scheduling ~~enable_context_parallel~~ / ~~enable_dsa_cp~~ Removed Superseded by PCP (enabling dsa_cp on main errors with a PCP hint)

docs.title: 6. KV Reuse & Pooling
docs.text:
Two ways to "stop paying recompute for KV": KVPP splits redundant per-layer MLA/SFA KV across TP ranks within one node (same memory, longer context); KV pooling (Ascend Store) shares KV across nodes. Note pooling is not an additional-config flag — its entry is --kv-transfer-config.

Flag One-liner When to enable enable_kvpp KV layer-wise parallelism across TP ranks Prefill node only (official); requires PIECEWISE graph mode kv_pool_range_debug Audit logging for KV pool layer-wise transfers Debug only; keep off in normal runs

Pooling config → Engine args overview · KV pooling topic · official KV Cache Pool

docs.title: 7. Speculative Decoding
docs.text:
A small draft model predicts tokens that the large model verifies in one pass — trading acceptance rate for decode speed. This family governs dynamic speculation (adaptive draft length by load) and draft KV sliding window (draft attends to only the last N tokens).

Flag One-liner When to enable dynamic_spec_config Dynamic speculative decoding config Fluctuating load where adaptive draft length pays off draft_window_size Draft KV sliding window (draft sees last N tokens) Long context + eagle3/dflash paths; output quality unchanged

Related engine arg: --speculative-config · official speculative decoding guide

docs.title: 8. Stability & Monitoring: Runtime Guard
docs.text:
vLLM-Ascend's online anomaly detection and incident-response layer: it watches decode-time signals (token repetition, garbled text, non-finite logits, speculative acceptance-rate drift, etc.), writes structured reports on trigger, and can optionally dump request-level KV cache blocks. Everything is off by default with negligible overhead; open switches level by level when investigating.

Flag One-liner When to enable runtime_config Startup overlay layer for runtime config Tune detectors/dump quotas online runtime_config_path Runtime Guard JSON path Config not at the default location runtime_config_hot_reload Hot-reload runtime config Change config without restart dump_config Inline msprobe dump config Integrating the msprobe debugger dump_config_path msprobe dump config file path Legacy option msmonitor_use_daemon msmonitor daemon mode Per monitoring deployment needs ascend_log_path vLLM-Ascend log path Default ~/ascend/log/vllm_ascend

docs.title: 9. Training & RL
docs.text:
RL training (rollout inference + weight sync) needs special inference-side cooperation. This family covers one-shot RL mode (force-disables inference-time optimizations, sets dev mode), global config refresh (reset Ascend config in training loops), and the rejection sampler (block/entropy two-level verification).

Flag One-liner When to enable rl_config One-shot RL mode master switch When wiring RL training frameworks; forces weight_nz_mode=0 etc. refresh Refresh global Ascend config RLHF training loops / test cases resetting config each iteration rejection_sampler_config Rejection sampler (block / entropy verify) RL rollout sampling quality filtering

Related engine args: RL family (--weight-transfer-config etc.) in engine args overview · official RL guide

docs.title: Environment Variables → --additional-config Migration Table
docs.text:
Since PR #9064 (2026-05), vLLM-Ascend is migrating environment variables to --additional-config.

  • Now: both env vars and --additional-config are supported during the transition;
  • Recommendation: use --additional-config for new deployments and migrate existing configs;
  • Future: env vars will be removed in a future release (tracking: issue #10381).

docs.title: Quick reference
docs.text: Env var Config key Type conversion VLLM_ASCEND_BALANCE_SCHEDULING scheduler_config.enable_balance_scheduling "1" → true, "0" → false VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_FLASHCOMM1 enable_flashcomm1 "1" → true, "0" → false VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_MATMUL_ALLREDUCE enable_matmul_allreduce "1" → true, "0" → false VLLM_ASCEND_FLASHCOMM2_PARALLEL_SIZE enable_flashcomm2_parallel_size integer (unchanged) MSMONITOR_USE_DAEMON msmonitor_use_daemon "1" → true, "0" → false VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_MLAPO enable_mlapo "1" → true, "0" → false VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_NZ weight_nz_mode integer (unchanged, key renamed) VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_CONTEXT_PARALLEL enable_context_parallel "1" → true, "0" → false VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_FUSED_MC2 enable_fused_mc2 integer (unchanged) VLLM_ASCEND_FUSION_OP_TRANSPOSE_KV_CACHE_BY_BLOCK enable_transpose_kv_cache_by_block "1" → true, "0" → false VLLM_ASCEND_KVPOOL_RANGE_DEBUG kvpool_range_debug "1" → true, "0" → false

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
Before (env var):

export VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_MLAPO=1
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B

After (--additional-config):

vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B --additional-config='{"enable_mlapo": true}'

Nested key migration (balance scheduling):

# Before
export VLLM_ASCEND_BALANCE_SCHEDULING=1

# After
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B \
  --additional-config='{"scheduler_config": {"enable_balance_scheduling": true}}'

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
1. weight_nz_mode was renamed: the old env var is VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_NZ; the new key is weight_nz_mode, and its semantics expanded from on/off to a three-mode switch (see weight_nz_mode).
  2. Mind the nesting: keys like enable_balance_scheduling and recompute_scheduler_enable now live under scheduler_config.
  3. Precedence: if the same field is provided in both formats during the transition, the value inside scheduler_config wins.
  4. Legacy top-level keys still parse: enable_balance_scheduling, recompute_scheduler_enable, short_request_first_config and profiling_chunk_config remain accepted as top-level keys, but are all deprecated.
  5. Some migration targets were later removed: VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_MATMUL_ALLREDUCE, VLLM_ASCEND_FLASHCOMM2_PARALLEL_SIZE and others were removed in v0.30.0 shortly after migration — check the version support matrix before upgrading.

docs.title: Quick Start: --additional-config
docs.text:
vLLM-Ascend feature flags are passed through vLLM's --additional-config argument as a JSON object.

Transition period

Since PR #9064, environment variables are migrating to --additional-config. Both work during the transition, but use --additional-config for new deployments — env vars will be removed in a future release. See the migration table.

docs.title: Online serving (vllm serve)
docs.text:
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B \
  --additional-config='{"enable_fused_mc2": 1, "weight_nz_mode": 2}'

docs.title: Offline inference (Python API)
docs.text:
from vllm import LLM

llm = LLM(
    model="Qwen/Qwen3-8B",
    additional_config={
        "enable_fused_mc2": 1,
        "weight_nz_mode": 2,
    },
)

docs.title: Nested configs
docs.text:
Some flags are dict-typed, e.g. scheduler and EPLB configs:

vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B \
  --additional-config='{
    "scheduler_config": {"enable_balance_scheduling": true},
    "eplb_config": {"dynamic_eplb": true}
  }'

Dynamic EPLB requirement

Besides eplb_config.dynamic_eplb: true, the env var DYNAMIC_EPLB=true must also be set as a safety guard, or startup fails an assertion. See dynamic_eplb.

docs.title: Common engine args: graph capture mode
docs.text:
--additional-config is the star of this handbook, but in real deployments it is most often paired with the vLLM engine arg --compilation-config for graph capture mode. The canonical recipe for a PD-disaggregated decode node:

vllm serve <model> \
  --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_DECODE_ONLY"}'
  • Semantics: full graphs for decode batches only; prefill and mixed batches run ungraphed — protects TPOT on the D node. This is the mainstream recipe in official PD tutorials.
  • Upstream default when unset: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE — full graphs for decode, piecewise graphs for prefill and mixed batches.
  • Deep dive: --compilation-config detail page (values, default resolution, auto capture sizes, official recipe index).

docs.title: Common pitfalls
docs.text: Error Cause Fix must be either '0' or '1' A strict-binary flag received an unexpected string Use JSON true/false for bool flags Flag has no effect Misspelled key or wrong nesting Check the key and nesting against the overview Startup config conflict Mutually exclusive flags both set (e.g. enable_force_eplb + eplb_config.dynamic_eplb) See the conflicts field on each detail page enable_flashcomm1 errors on MRv2 FlashComm1 only supports Model Runner V1 Use PCP on MRv2; see version notes

docs.text:
Tracks flag introductions, default changes, deprecations and removals. The per-flag data lives in data/flags/*.yaml (status / version_support / version_note); this page summarizes version-level events.

Verified by diffing vllm_ascend/envs.py and vllm_ascend/ascend_config.py at each release tag. See the version support matrix.

docs.text:

  • The scheduler_config canonical nesting did not exist yet; scheduler flags were top-level keys or env vars.

docs.title: v0.30.0 (current stable release, biggest delta)
docs.text:
14 flags added:

  • Scheduler family: scheduler_config (canonical nesting), short_request_first_config, batch_job_sched_config, dyntra_lb_config
  • MoE communication: mc2_comm_alg (replaces enable_mc2_hierarchy_comm), combine_quant_mode

4 flags removed:

Removed flag Note enable_matmul_allreduce Env var only in v0.23.0; no direct replacement enable_flashcomm2_parallel_size FlashComm2 config; no direct replacement multistream_overlap_gate Gate multi-stream overlap; see multistream_overlap_shared_expert for shared-expert overlap weight_prefetch_config Weight prefetch; see ascend_warmup_config

docs.title: vLLM Engine Args Overview (Ascend context)
docs.text:
Tables on this page are auto-generated from data/engine-args.yaml by scripts/generate_tables.py. Do not edit the table region by hand.

Inclusion rule: only args that actually appear in vLLM-Ascend official docs (model tutorials, feature guides, quick_start, FAQs). Every arg exists in the vLLM source CLI definitions. 78 args, grouped into 9 categories.

Args here are top-level vllm serve command-line args (--xxx), defined by upstream vLLM and cross-platform; Ascend-plugin-specific config keys (AscendConfig fields passed via the --additional-config JSON) live in the feature flags overview.

📍 Ascend configuration has 6 entry points in total — this page is just one of them. Start from the configuration entry points overview (covers CLI value-domain patches, env vars, runtime_config.json and other entries not listed here).

docs.title: Relationship to official docs
docs.text:
• vLLM's official args docs cover 270+ args; this table focuses on the Ascend deployment context (real usage in official tutorials, recommended values, Ascend notes).
  • Each arg's "Official docs" column links to the specific tutorial page it was taken from — click through to see the original command line.
  • Defaults come from the vLLM source dataclass definitions (ParallelConfig/ModelConfig/VllmConfig), not prose.
  • Key args have dedicated detail pages (linked arg names).

docs.title: Parallelism
docs.text: Argument Type Default Description Official docs --api-server-count str None Number of API server processes. Improves request ingress throughput under high concurrency. docs×9 --data-parallel-address str None Address of the data parallel cluster head node. docs×20 --data-parallel-backend DataParallelBackend "mp" DP backend implementation. Default 'mp'; use 'ray' for Ray clusters. docs×1 --data-parallel-rank int None Data parallel rank of this instance (headless / Ray mode). docs×7 --data-parallel-rpc-port int None Fixed port for DP RPC communication. Required for multi-node DP. docs×18 --data-parallel-size int 1 Number of data parallel groups. MoE experts are sharded by TP×PCP×DP. docs.title: Topic: KV pooling (Ascend Store)
docs.text:
KV pooling (KV Cache Pool / Ascend Store) is cross-node KV-cache pooling storage: the KV cache is written to an external backend (mooncake / memcache / yuanrong) and shared across vLLM instances under PD disaggregation, so identical prefixes skip redundant prefill. It is not an --additional-config flag — which is why it is absent from the feature-flags overview. The entry point is the --kv-transfer-config AscendStoreConnector on this page:

What you want to configure Where Connector fields (backend / use_layerwise / lookup_rpc_port) kv-transfer-config detail page, "KV 池化" section: per-field breakdown + full example Pooling + P2P transport combined (MultiConnector) Same as above Layerwise-transfer debug logging Flag kv_pool_range_debug Concepts, architecture, deployment details Official KV Cache Pool (Ascend Store) · Mooncake layerwise pooling

docs.title: --additional-config
docs.text:
Platform extension config (JSON dict) — the sole entry point for all 64 vLLM-Ascend feature flags: the reason this handbook exists.

Property Value Type dict Default {} Category Server

docs.title: Official definition
docs.text:
Additional config for specified platform. Different platforms may support different configs. Make sure the configs are valid for the platform you are using. Contents must be hashable.

(vLLM source: VllmConfig.additional_config, Field(default_factory=dict), config/vllm.py)

docs.title: How it works
docs.text:
Layered design: the vLLM core CLI only has engine-generic args; platform-specific configs (CUDA/ROCm/NPU) go through this pass-through channel — vLLM does not parse the contents; the platform plugin validates and consumes them. The vLLM-Ascend plugin consumes all 63 feature flags here (MoE fusion, RL mode, scheduler extensions, Runtime Guard, etc.).

Where the keys come from: valid keys are defined in vllm-ascend source (vllm_ascend/ascend_config.py and vllm_ascend/envs.py) and verified key-by-key on this site — anything without a provenance is not listed (see the feature flags overview).

Mind the "hashable" constraint (source docstring): contents must be hashable (they participate in the config cache key) — use primitive/immutable JSON values.

Migration background: since PR #9064, vLLM-Ascend env-var switches migrated to --additional-config; both work during the transition, and env vars will be removed in a future release. See the migration table.

docs.title: Usage patterns
docs.text:
# single key
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B --additional-config='{"enable_fused_mc2": 1}'

# combined (the norm in official tutorials)
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B \
  --additional-config='{"enable_cpu_binding":true,"enable_flashcomm1":true}'

# nested (compilation config)
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B \
  --additional-config='{"ascend_compilation_config":{"enable_npugraph_ex":true,"enable_static_kernel":false}}'

docs.title: --block-size
docs.text:
Physical KV cache block size (in tokens) — affects prefix-cache hit granularity and fragmentation.

Property Value Type int Default None ("use default"; the engine resolves it from the attention backend page size — source comment in cache.py) Category Scheduling & Memory

docs.title: Official definition
docs.text:
Size of a contiguous cache block in number of tokens.

(vLLM source: CacheConfig.block_size, Field(default=None, gt=0), comment "Accepts None (meaning 'use default'). After construction, always int.", cache.py)

docs.title: How it works
docs.text:
Blocks are the KV allocation unit: vLLM does not allocate KV token-by-token; it takes/releases memory in whole fixed-size blocks. A request asks for N blocks; on completion, blocks are returned.

Two direct consequences:

  1. Fragmentation: a sequence of length L occupies ceil(L / block_size) blocks — the last block wastes half on average. Bigger blocks mean more internal fragmentation;
  2. Prefix-cache granularity: prefix caching hits at block boundaries. Bigger blocks mean coarser hits (shared boundaries must align to a block) but less metadata overhead.

In source, prefix_match_unit (the finest token boundary a prefix hit can land on) has a divisibility check: "prefix-cacheable KV cache group block sizes must be divisible by prefix_match_unit" (kv_cache_utils.py) — the coupling between block size and hit granularity is a hard constraint in code.

docs.title: Parameter interplay
docs.text:
Related arg Relationship --enable-prefix-caching Hit granularity = block boundary; fine-grained hits need both tuned --kv-cache-dtype KV quantization changes bytes per token; together with block size it sets per-block memory Ascend KV-layout flags (enable_kv_nz, KVPP) Layout features impose their own block-size/alignment requirements — follow the feature docs

Rule of thumb: smaller blocks → less fragmentation, finer hits, more metadata overhead; larger blocks → less overhead, more fragmentation and coarser hits. The resolved default suits most workloads — official tutorials that set it explicitly do so for a specific reason (below).

docs.title: Ascend context & official usage
docs.text:
• Explicit values and their context in official tutorials:
  • 32 — DeepSeek-V4-Pro, paired with --kv-cache-dtype fp8 (fp8 KV block layout)
  • 128 / 1536 — KVPP and other KV-pooling scenarios
  • Don't copy those values blindly: 128/1536 belong to specific feature combinations. For general deployment, the resolved default is the right baseline.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text: vllm serve deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.2 --block-size 32 --kv-cache-dtype fp8

docs.title: Related args
docs.text:
• --kv-cache-dtype — commonly configured together
  • --enable-prefix-caching — hit granularity depends on block boundaries

docs.title: --compilation-config (-cc)
docs.text:
torch.compile and CUDA Graph capture configuration — the core production-performance knob, controlling which steps are captured and at which sizes.

Property Value Type CompilationConfig (JSON, or -cc.key=value dotted overrides) Default CompilationConfig() (sub-fields carry their own defaults, e.g. cudagraph_mode) Category Compilation & Graphs

docs.title: Official definition
docs.text:
torch.compile and cudagraph capture configuration for the model. As a shorthand, one can append compilation arguments via -cc.parameter=argument.

(vLLM source: EngineArgs.compilation_config, arg_utils.py)

docs.title: How it works
docs.text:
What it governs: two subsystems — torch.compile (compiling the model into better kernel sequences) and CUDA Graph (whole-graph replay). Key sub-fields:

Sub-field Role cudagraph_mode Capture scope — 5 possible values (table below) cudagraph_capture_sizes Explicit list of batch sizes to capture max_cudagraph_capture_size Upper bound on capture sizes

Full cudagraph_mode values (vLLM source CUDAGraphMode enum):

Value Semantics NONE No graph capture (--enforce-eager forces this) PIECEWISE Piecewise graphs only; graph-incompatible ops (e.g. some attention) stay outside FULL Full-graph capture for all batches (unsupported by some backends) FULL_DECODE_ONLY Full graphs for decode batches only; prefill / mixed batches run ungraphed FULL_AND_PIECEWISE Full graphs for decode, piecewise for prefill and mixed batches — the v1 engine default

Why decode steps need graphs most: each decode step is a single forward (1 token per sequence), where kernel-launch and CPU scheduling dominate; replaying the whole step as one graph maximizes TPOT gains. Prefill steps are compute-heavy with varying shapes — little capture benefit, frequent misses. This is why official tutorials favor FULL_DECODE_ONLY.

Two ways to pass it (confirmed in the source docstring):

--compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_DECODE_ONLY"}'   # full JSON
-cc.cudagraph_mode=FULL_DECODE_ONLY                            # dotted shorthand

docs.title: Parameter interplay
docs.text:
Mutually exclusive with --enforce-eager: eager on = this entire config is inert (see enforce-eager).

Capture-size formula vs scheduling args (Ascend fine-grained TP, Fine_grained_TP guide):

the max capture size must cover min(max_num_batched_tokens, max_num_seqs × (1 + num_speculative_tokens))

Otherwise oproj/mlp fine-grained TP is auto-disabled with a warning at startup. On the vLLM side, max_cudagraph_capture_size is also truncated by the Ascend platform layer based on available memory (vllm-ascend platform.py).

Speculative decoding linkage: with num_speculative_tokens > 0, decode steps carry 1 + n tokens per sequence — the capture-size enumeration must cover those shapes (same formula).

docs.title: Tuning guidance
docs.text: Scenario Suggestion Production default (official mainstream) {"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_DECODE_ONLY"} — decode captured, prefill free-form Fixed batch shapes Enumerate cudagraph_capture_sizes explicitly (official Qwen3-Dense recipe), skipping auto-probing Tight memory Shrink the capture-size list / lower max_cudagraph_capture_size; last resort --enforce-eager

docs.title: Ascend context & official usage
docs.text:
• High-frequency values in official tutorials:
  • --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_DECODE_ONLY"}' (Kimi-K3, DeepSeek-V4 family)
  • --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_capture_sizes":[4,8,12,16,20,...]}' (Qwen3-Dense etc.)
  • Mind the layering vs Ascend-side graph switches (enable_npugraph_ex in ascend_compilation_config, xlite_graph_config): this arg is the vLLM layer; those are the Ascend platform layer; the final graph mode is arbitrated by platform code.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B \
  --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_DECODE_ONLY"}'
# or dotted override
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B -cc.cudagraph_mode=FULL_DECODE_ONLY

docs.title: Related args
docs.text:
• --enforce-eager — the mutually exclusive master switch
  • --max-num-seqs — input to the capture-size formula
  • --speculative-config — affects decode-step shapes

docs.title: --data-parallel-size
docs.text:
Data parallel (DP) group count — scaling concurrency via replicas; the scale source for MoE expert parallelism (EP).

Property Value Type int Default 1 Category Parallelism

docs.title: Official definition
docs.text:
Number of data parallel groups. MoE layers will be sharded according to the product of the tensor, prefill-context, and data parallel sizes.

(vLLM source: ParallelConfig.data_parallel_size, parallel.py; emphasis in the original source)

docs.title: How it works
docs.text:
What gets sliced: requests. Each DP replica is a complete, independent stack of "TP×PP workers + scheduler", serving its own request queue. Replicas sync metadata (scheduling, load balancing) over RPC; the head node fronts the API layer.

The extra meaning for MoE (source docstring): with --enable-expert-parallel on, MoE experts are sharded by the product TP × PCP × DP — each +1 of DP divides the per-rank expert count further. This is why large-MoE "EP scale" is tuned mainly via DP, not TP.

Multi-node DP companions (all required):

Argument Role --data-parallel-size-local replicas on this node (source check: must be ≤ data_parallel_size, parallel.py) --data-parallel-start-rank this node's starting rank --data-parallel-address head node address --data-parallel-rpc-port fixed RPC port

Non-head nodes additionally take --headless (inference only, no API server).

Another source check: data_parallel_size_external_lb is only valid with data_parallel_size > 1 (parallel.py).

docs.title: Parameter interplay
docs.text:
Related arg Relationship --enable-expert-parallel DP is the primary EP scale knob (experts split by TP×PCP×DP) --tensor-parallel-size multiplies with DP to set per-rank expert count --prefill-context-parallel-size the third factor in expert sharding Ascend enable_balance_scheduling request balancing across DP replicas

Analogy: DP is opening more branch stores — each store is a full copy (full worker stack), store count = concurrent serving capacity. For MoE, more stores means the HQ's scarce talent (experts) can be divided more thinly.

docs.title: Ascend context & official usage
docs.text:
• Standard combination in official MoE tutorials: --enable-expert-parallel --data-parallel-size N --tensor-parallel-size M (DeepSeek-V4-Pro, Kimi-K3, GLM5.2, etc.).
  • Official multi-node tutorials use the --data-parallel-* family for node addressing; non-head nodes take --headless.
  • Ascend-specific: replica balancing via enable_balance_scheduling.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
# 2-node DP=8, 4 replicas per node (second node shown)
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B \
  --enable-expert-parallel --data-parallel-size 8 \
  --data-parallel-size-local 4 --data-parallel-start-rank 4 \
  --data-parallel-address $HEAD_IP --data-parallel-rpc-port 29500 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 8

docs.title: Related args
docs.text:
• --enable-expert-parallel — DP is the EP scale source
  • --tensor-parallel-size — multiplies with DP for per-rank expert count
  • --headless / --distributed-executor-backend — multi-node companions

docs.title: --distributed-executor-backend
docs.text:
Distributed executor backend: how workers are spawned and communicate — mp (multi-process) or ray.

Property Value Type str Default None (auto-selected) Category Parallelism

docs.title: Official definition
docs.text:
Backend to use for distributed model workers, either "mp" (multi-process) or "ray" (Ray, distributed).

(vLLM source: ParallelConfig.distributed_executor_backend, parallel.py)

docs.title: How it works
docs.text:
It governs the worker lifecycle: once TP/PP is decided, this backend manages how each worker process is created, how they discover each other, and how they run collective communication.

  • mp (multi-process): vLLM spawns local processes via multiprocessing. Zero external dependency, fast startup, low overhead — but processes stay on one node;
  • ray: workers become Ray actors. Requires a Ray cluster and starts heavier, but natively supports multi-node — workers can land on any cluster node.

Distinct from --data-parallel-backend: this arg selects the executor backend for the TP/PP worker layer; --data-parallel-backend (mp/ray) selects the backend for the DP replica layer. The two are chosen independently.

docs.title: Parameter interplay
docs.text:
Related arg Relationship --tensor-parallel-size TP across nodes → ray required; single-node allows either --pipeline-parallel-size PP across nodes → ray required --data-parallel-backend DP-layer backend, chosen independently

Rule of thumb (matching official usage): mp for a single node, ray for multi-node. mp starts faster with fewer dependencies; once workers must span nodes, ray is the only option.

docs.title: Ascend context & official usage
docs.text:
• Explicit values in official tutorials:
  • mp — single node, e.g. Qwen3-Dense: --distributed-executor-backend "mp"
  • ray — multi-node large models, e.g. DeepSeek-V4-Pro
  • Ascend multi-node tutorials pair with the Ray cluster docs (tutorials/features/ray).

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
# single node
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B --tensor-parallel-size 8 --distributed-executor-backend mp
# multi-node
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B --tensor-parallel-size 16 --distributed-executor-backend ray

docs.title: Related args
docs.text:
• --data-parallel-backend — DP-layer backend (mp/ray)
  • --tensor-parallel-size — the single-node vs multi-node factor

docs.title: --enable-chunked-prefill / --no-enable-chunked-prefill
docs.text:
Chunked prefill: long prompts are split against the remaining max_num_batched_tokens budget and digested across scheduler steps — long requests no longer starve decode.

Property Value Type bool Default None → auto per model support (on for supporting models) Category Scheduling & Memory

docs.title: Official definition
docs.text:
If True, prefill requests can be chunked based on the remaining max_num_batched_tokens.

(vLLM source: SchedulerConfig.enable_chunked_prefill, scheduler.py)

docs.title: How it works
docs.text:
Without chunking: a 32K-token prompt forces the scheduler to free a 32K-token budget within a single step — every decode request waits in line meanwhile. One long request degrades TPOT for everyone. This is "prefill starving decode".

With chunking: the prompt is split by budget and advanced chunk-by-chunk; decode requests interleave between chunks. Two consequences:

  • ✅ Smoother TPOT: decode is no longer suppressed by long prefills;
  • ⚠️ Longer TTFT: total prefill time stretches (chunks compete for budget).

Default auto-resolution (arg_utils.py _set_default_chunked_prefill_and_prefix_caching_args):

None → model_config.is_chunked_prefill_supported (auto-on when supported)

So on main, supporting models have it on by default. Two exception paths (same function):

  • Manually disabling it on a supporting model → warning: "This model does not officially support disabling chunked prefill... may cause the engine to crash or produce incorrect outputs";
  • Encoder-decoder models are auto-disabled in source (scheduler.py, disable_chunked_mm_input branch).

docs.title: Parameter interplay
docs.text:
With max_num_batched_tokens — the chunk size IS it: with chunking on, a "chunk" is the budget granted to that request per step. Tuning max_num_batched_tokens tunes the chunk size.

Startup validation against max_model_len (scheduler.py verify_max_model_len):

chunking off: max_num_batched_tokens < max_model_len → startup error
chunking on:  constraint lifted (long sequences digest in chunks)

This is why long-context deployments almost always enable it: the prerequisite for running long contexts on a small budget.

Preemption linkage: chunking makes per-step KV growth of long requests smaller (one chunk written per step), smoothing pool pressure; vllm:num_preemptions fluctuates less than without chunking.

docs.title: Tuning guidance
docs.text: Scenario Suggestion Mixed long/short traffic (typical online serving) Keep on (default) TTFT-first with known prompt lengths Can disable, but must ensure max_num_batched_tokens ≥ max_model_len (else startup error), and accept decode jitter CPP dynamic chunking (Ascend PP) Chunking is the prerequisite; pair with profiling_chunk_config for dynamic sizing

docs.title: Ascend context & official usage
docs.text:
• Default on vLLM main: auto-on for supporting models. Official tutorials pass --enable-chunked-prefill explicitly for large-model long-context (Qwen3.5-397B family), paired with large max_num_batched_tokens (16384+) for chunk sizing.
  • Ascend's CPP (dynamic chunked pipeline parallelism) builds on chunking: the chunk size equals max_num_batched_tokens; tuning space [8192, 16384, 24576, 32768] (official CPP guide).

docs.title: Usage
docs.text: vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B --enable-chunked-prefill --max-num-batched-tokens 16384

docs.title: Related args
docs.text:
• --max-num-batched-tokens — the actual chunk size
  • --max-model-len — startup constraint when chunking is off
  • profiling_chunk_config — Ascend dynamic chunking config

docs.title: --enable-expert-parallel
docs.text:
Shard MoE layers with expert parallelism (EP): experts are distributed across devices instead of being tensor-parallel-sliced.

Property Value Type bool Default False Category Parallelism

docs.title: Official definition
docs.text:
Use expert parallelism instead of tensor parallelism for MoE layers.

(vLLM source: ParallelConfig.enable_expert_parallel, parallel.py)

docs.title: How it works
docs.text:
Why MoE needs it: the weight bulk of a large MoE model lives in the expert FFNs (many experts, large per-layer parameter count). The default TP slicing splits every expert across all TP devices — memory shrinks by 1/TP, but expert compute for every token needs a cross-device all-reduce, and once TP exceeds the KV head count, the attention side stops saving memory (see tensor-parallel-size).

EP switches the approach: whole experts are assigned to different devices (sharded by the TP × PCP × DP product with DP), and each token routes only to a few experts on the local device. Cross-device communication changes from "two all-reduces per layer" to "routing-driven dispatch/combine".

Source hard constraint (model.py _verify_with_expert_parallelism):

with enable_expert_parallel, the model must be is_moe (num experts > 0),
otherwise ValueError

Enabling this on a Dense model fails at startup.

docs.title: Parameter interplay
docs.text:
Related arg Relationship --data-parallel-size experts sharded by the TP × PCP × DP product — DP is the main EP scale knob --tensor-parallel-size multiplies with DP to set per-rank expert count Ascend enable_fused_mc2 / mc2_comm_alg fused MoE dispatch/combine and its communication algorithm Ascend dynamic_eplb / enable_force_eplb expert load balancing (EPLB) Ascend mega_moe_max_tokens per-rank token capacity cap for the fused MC2/MegaMoe path

The cost, said plainly: EP changes the communication pattern from "fixed all-reduce per layer" to "routing-driven all-to-all", and load imbalance is an inherent risk — a routing-hot device hits its compute ceiling first. That is exactly why the EPLB flag family exists.

docs.title: Ascend context & official usage
docs.text:
• Enabled by default in official MoE tutorials (DeepSeek-V4 family, Kimi-K3 family, GLM5.2, Qwen3.5-397B, MiniMax-M3, etc.), combined with --data-parallel-size N --tensor-parallel-size M (M×DP sets per-rank expert count).
  • Official MoE communication optimization goes through enable_fused_mc2 (dispatch-FFN-combine fusion) and mc2_comm_alg.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text: vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B --enable-expert-parallel --data-parallel-size 4

docs.title: Related args
docs.text:
• --data-parallel-size — EP scale source (expert sharding product factor)
  • --tensor-parallel-size — multiplies with DP for per-rank expert count
  • enable_fused_mc2 — MoE communication fusion (Ascend flag)

docs.title: --enable-prefix-caching / --no-enable-prefix-caching
docs.text:
Prefix caching: reuse KV blocks of shared prefixes — a big TTFT win for multi-turn chat and shared system prompts.

Property Value Type bool Default None (auto per model/backend — see below) Category Scheduling & Memory

docs.title: Official definition
docs.text:
Whether to enable prefix caching.

(vLLM source: CacheConfig.enable_prefix_caching, cache.py)

docs.title: How it works
docs.text:
The principle: if request 1 and request 2 share a prompt prefix (same system prompt, or a multi-turn history), their KV blocks over that span are identical. When enabled, the scheduler hashes block contents and reuses identical blocks — request 2 skips prefill over the whole shared span, cutting that part of TTFT entirely.

Default auto-resolution (when omitted from the CLI, EngineArgs judges by model capability, arg_utils.py _set_default_chunked_prefill_and_prefix_caching_args):

None → model_config.is_prefix_caching_supported (auto-on when the model/backend supports it)

So on main, "unset" usually means "on" — unless the model or backend explicitly lacks support.

docs.title: Parameter interplay
docs.text:
Related arg Relationship --block-size Hit granularity = block boundary; prefix_match_unit must divide the block size (source-level hard check) --kv-transfer-config explicitly disabled under PD disaggregation (below) Ascend KV-layout flags (enable_kv_nz) Affect the underlying block layout used by prefix caching

Conflict with PD disaggregation (important): in the official PD disaggregation (Mooncake) tutorial, both prefill and decode nodes pass --no-enable-prefix-caching. Reason: under PD, KV moves between nodes and prefix-reuse semantics are owned by the KV transfer layer; enabling local prefix caching on top creates duplicated/conflicting semantics. Rule of thumb: PD on → local prefix caching off.

docs.title: Tuning guidance
docs.text: Scenario Suggestion Multi-turn chat / shared system prompt Enable (the auto default is usually enough) — significant TTFT gains PD disaggregation Disable (--no-enable-prefix-caching, per the official tutorial) Single-turn short prompts, no shared prefix Zero benefit either way

docs.title: Ascend context & official usage
docs.text:
• PD disaggregation tutorials (Mooncake single/multi-node): both prefill and decode nodes use --no-enable-prefix-caching.
  • General online serving: rely on auto-resolution (on by default).

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
# general serving (explicit on)
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B --enable-prefix-caching

# PD disaggregation nodes (off, per official tutorial)
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B --no-enable-prefix-caching --kv-transfer-config '{...}'

docs.title: Related args
docs.text:
• --block-size — hit granularity
  • --kv-transfer-config — PD interplay

docs.title: --enforce-eager
docs.text:
Force eager execution: skip torch.compile and CUDA Graph capture — trading performance for debuggability.

Property Value Type bool Default False Category Compilation & Graphs

docs.title: Official definition
docs.text:
Always use eager-mode PyTorch. If False, will use torch.compile and use fast CUDA Graphs when possible.

(vLLM source: ModelConfig.enforce_eager, model.py)

docs.title: How it works
docs.text:
Why graph capture is fast: the production path compiles/captures model computation into CUDA Graphs — a fixed kernel sequence replayed whole, eliminating per-step CPU scheduling and kernel-launch overhead. Decode steps benefit most (small compute per step, high scheduling share).

What eager gives up: every forward goes through PyTorch dynamic dispatch. Behavior is fully transparent and errors directly traceable — at the cost of markedly worse TPOT (eager deployments typically pair with lower concurrency).

When to enable it: it is not a performance knob but a debugging / emergency switch:

  1. First-deployment debugging — on accuracy anomalies, garbled outputs, or startup hangs, use it to rule out graph-capture/compile factors and narrow the search;
  2. Memory emergency — capture itself consumes memory; on huge models, trade it for weight/KV headroom;
  3. Fallback when a feature combination doesn't support graphs (judge per feature docs).

docs.title: Parameter interplay
docs.text:
Related arg Relationship --compilation-config the "master-switch opposite": eager on = all graph config inert Ascend ascend_compilation_config vllm-ascend platform.py derives the graph mode from this arg plus that flag (get_compilation_mode) Ascend xlite_graph_config the other Ascend graph path, mutually exclusive with eager --speculative-config draft side often uses enforce_eager:true (official Kimi-K3 recipe) to skip graph capture for the draft model

Analogy: graph capture is "recording the whole assembly line on tape" — playback is fast, but recording takes space and any mid-process change requires a re-record; eager is "operating live every step" — slower, but everything is visible.

docs.title: Ascend context & official usage
docs.text:
• Two scenarios where official tutorials enable it explicitly:
  • Debugging — accuracy/startup investigations;
  • Tight memory on huge models — e.g. Qwen3.5-397B-A17B passes --enforce-eager to leave memory for weights and KV.
  • Keep off in production (default False) for graph-capture performance; before enabling, confirm the benefit outweighs the TPOT loss.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text: vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B --enforce-eager   # debugging

docs.title: Related args
docs.text:
• --compilation-config — graph capture policy (inert when this arg is on)
  • ascend_compilation_config / xlite_graph_config — Ascend-side graph configs

docs.title: --gpu-memory-utilization
docs.text:
Fraction of device memory the model executor may use (0–1) — the source of the KV cache pool size.

Property Value Type float (0–1) Default None → resolves to 1.0 (extensible KV cache) or 0.92 (otherwise) — vLLM main source, resolved_gpu_memory_utilization Category Scheduling & Memory

docs.title: Official definition
docs.text:
The fraction of GPU memory to be used for the model executor, which can range from 0 to 1. For example, a value of 0.5 would imply 50% GPU memory utilization. This is a per-instance limit, and only applies to the current vLLM instance... On non-GPU installs, this value controls the corresponding device memory utilization.

(vLLM source: CacheConfig.gpu_memory_utilization, cache.py)

Two takeaways:

  1. Per-instance limit: it constrains the current vLLM instance only. When co-locating multiple instances on one device, each takes its own share;
  2. Applies to NPU too: "On non-GPU installs, this value controls the corresponding device memory utilization" — on Ascend it controls NPU HBM.

docs.title: How it works
docs.text:
The exact default semantics (resolved_gpu_memory_utilization, property):

explicitly set → use the explicit value
unset          → enable_extensible_kv_cache ? 1.0 : DEFAULT_GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION (0.92)

So on main, "unset" is not a single number: 1.0 with the extensible KV cache (pool sized from measured memory), 0.92 on the traditional path (DEFAULT_GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION constant).

Where the memory goes: the fraction covers everything the model executor uses — weights, KV cache, activations. vLLM loads the weights and profiles at startup; the remainder becomes the KV cache pool:

KV pool ≈ total device memory × this arg − model weights − activation/workspace reserve

Weights dominate the difference (or shrink it, when quantized) — which is why quantized-model tutorials can afford 0.9 or higher.

docs.title: Parameter interplay
docs.text:
Versus effective concurrency (from the --max-num-seqs formula):

effective concurrency ≈ min(max_num_seqs, KV pool capacity ÷ average context length)
                            ↑
                    this parameter decides this term

If max_num_seqs is maxed out and you still need more concurrency, there are only two levers: raise this arg (bigger pool), or shrink per-request usage (max_model_len, kv-cache-dtype).

Preemption linkage: a full pool triggers preemption (rising vllm:num_preemptions). This arg is the #1 pool-size knob — but don't push it to 1.0 and risk runtime OOM: the traditional path's 0.92 default exists precisely to leave headroom for runtime fluctuation.

Finer-grained alternative: to cap the KV cache by bytes instead of a ratio, use kv_cache_memory_bytes.

docs.title: Tuning guidance
docs.text: Scenario Suggestion Dedicated single-card production Start at 0.85–0.90 (the official tutorial range); tune upward after confirming no OOM Multiple instances on one card Split proportionally; sum ≤ 1 minus OS/runtime reserve Quantized weights Weights take less room — raise this to give the KV pool more OOM / profiling failure Lower this first; or use quantized weights / smaller max_model_len

docs.title: Ascend context & official usage
docs.text:
• Almost all official tutorials set it explicitly; observed range 0.80–0.90:
  • 0.80: Kimi-K3
  • 0.85: GLM5.3-Flash, Qwen3.5-27B
  • 0.90: many A2/A3 tutorials (e.g. DeepSeek-V4-Flash)
  • Quantized Ascend models (W8A8 etc.) leave more room for KV — one reason tutorials run 0.9 — but always confirm with the startup profiling output.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text: vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9

docs.title: Related args
docs.text:
